title: Meet your biology partner
objective: Introduce yourself. Ask about one thing your partner says.

slides.title: Listen to Mali
body: Mali: “Hi, I’m Mali. I study biology. I like frogs.”
Mali: “I hear them near my home after rain.”
Which word helped Nok choose her question?

slides.title: Build your introduction
body: Try it with a topic you know: birds, plants, or insects.

slides.title: Ask about what you heard
body: You hear “I like watching birds in the morning.”
Choose a question about the birds. Start with Where, When, or Why.
Ask it aloud. Your partner gives one detail.

slides.title: Meet a new partner
body: A: Introduce yourself in 30 seconds. Include a topic you like.
B: Listen. Ask one question about that topic.
A: Answer the question. Then swap roles.

slides.title: Introduce your partner
body: Tell another pair: “This is ___. They like ___ because ___.”
Your partner listens. Did you remember the topic and reason?
If a detail is missing, ask for it and try again.
